name: Canadian County, OK
findings: Canadian County has 269 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Canadian County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 24 would.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Canadian County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
